value.rationale: The claim gives a complete classification of all planar rectangular Cartesian path grids at the first rank capable of separating any members of the family. The exact five-class boundary includes a non-obvious equivalence between a 2-by-5 ladder and a 3-by-4 grid, and the ten-vertex representative ceiling is sharp. This is a natural bounded-logic invariant rather than an isolated or arbitrary finite computation.
